name: Craft & Ring
title: Craft & Ring: Minecraft Tiered Progression & Barricades
tagline: Forge Minecraft gear, mine materials from bosses, and drop physical block barricades in Elden Ring!
description: Craft & Ring brings Minecraft's iconic tiered progression and tactical block placement directly into Elden Ring's Lands Between. Start Limgrave with humble Wooden & Stone tools, hunt down enemies and boss drop materials, and craft Iron, Diamond, and Netherite weapons at Sites of Grace. Deploy physical Cobblestone and Dirt block barricades in mid-combat for tactical cover and defense!
